data.name: Namrata
data.gender_notes: Namrata is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit namra, 'bending, humble' — namratā, 'humility'. Its root is Sanskrit namra (नम्र). A classical Sanskrit term for humility. Namrata is a Sanskrit name meaning “Humility; modesty; submission”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Namrata expresses “Humility; modesty; submission”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit namra, 'bending, humble' — namratā, 'humility'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Namrata total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
